description:
Verified HTTP 200 (image/svg+xml). Official PTx Trimble lockup used as a partner-brand logo on a real Vantage dealer's website (Vantage NSW, a peer dealer to Vantage South). Vector SVG, viewBox 268x128 (~2.1:1, reasonable proportions, not an extreme crop). Single-color dark green (#033A26) mark (the pie/leaf icon) plus 'PTx Trimble' wordmark stacked as 'PTx' (bold) over 'Trimble' (light) -- includes the word 'Trimble' as requested. It IS color (dark green, not white), so it will render/show up fine against a white page background, though it is one color rather than full multi-color. This is the best balance of 'reasonable proportions + color + includes Trimble text + no extraneous badge text' that I could find.

Alternate candidate (fuller color palette, but has extra text baked in): https://produkter.geoteam.dk/Logo/PTx%20Trimble%20Authorized%20Dealer%20Logo%20(US%20ENG)%20-%20RGB/PTx-Trimble-Authorized-Logo-Horizontal-RGB-Multi.png -- verified HTTP 200, PNG 1900x694, full multi-color (orange/green icon + dark green 'PTx Trimble' text), but it's an 'authorized dealer' badge asset with a dark-green 'AUTHORIZED DEALER' bar across the bottom ~26% of the image (implying third-party dealer status rather than being PTx Trimble's own plain logo). The clean multi-color mark+wordmark without any badge could be produced by cropping that image/SVG to just the top portion, but I did not find a pre-cropped, officially hosted version of that combination (color + Trimble wordmark + no dealer badge) anywhere -- AGCO's own scene7 CDN only hosts either a white-only version (s7d9.scene7.com/is/image/agco/logos-trimble-300x200, includes 'Trimble' text but pure white) or a color version with a huge blank-canvas crop problem identical to the original 1200x60 sliver you flagged (s7d9.scene7.com/is/image/agco/header-ptx-c-90x60), plus a clean square color 'PTx' mark+wordmark WITHOUT the word 'Trimble' (https://news.agcocorp.com/image/PTx_Logo_Multi_RGB-300px.jpg, verified 200, JPG 300x300, full multi-color, good proportions, but says only 'PTx' not 'PTx Trimble').

Verified HTTP 200 (image/png, 16.7KB). Found via CapstanAg's own WordPress REST media API (wp-json/wp/v2/media), not Wayback Machine (web.archive.org was unreachable from this environment -- both the sandbox network egress policy and the fetch tool's proxy blocked it). This file was uploaded May 2018, pre-dating the 2023 Nordson acquisition co-branding. PNG, 1008x200 pixels (~5:1, a normal wide logo-lockup ratio, not an extreme sliver). Shows the full color diamond/dot mark (green diamond outline, blue gradient dots) plus the complete 'CapstanAg' wordmark rendered in dark grey with the '™' superscript, and 'AG' in a lighter grey -- this reads clearly against a white background, unlike the two logos you flagged (which were either icon-only or white-text-on-transparent that vanishes on white). This is the best available: a genuine, standalone, text-inclusive, color CapstanAg logo that shows up on white.

Note: I also found a similarly-styled white-text version (https://capstanag.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Logo_CMYK_White-Text_TM.png, verified 200, PNG 1008x200) which has the identical color icon and layout but white 'CapstanAg' text -- same invisible-on-white problem as your original find, so I did not recommend it. The current capstanag.com site (post-acquisition) no longer uses any text wordmark in its own header -- its live header/nav logo is icon-only (diamond mark) next to the separate Nordson Precision Agriculture and ARAG logos, confirming the standalone CapstanAg wordmark has effectively been retired from their current site and only survives in these older uploaded assets.
